> ### What is the user problem or growth opportunity you want to see solved?
> Currently deleting all browsing history won't delete logins. Since logins do have website information, this might leak private data. It would be great if we had a logins option in delete browsing data
> 
> ### How do you know that this problem exists today? Why is this important?
> As a user, I want to be able to delete all user data from within the app, or on a granular scale
> 
> ### Who will benefit from it?
> People who frequently delete browsing data
>
